source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice mcqs written from Unit 7 (PDF 220-233), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh Unit 7 (Kinematics of Motion in a Straight Line (TOC: 'Kinematics')) ke poore unit se practice MCQs hain, unit ke sections ki tarteeb mein. Har sawal ka aik sahi jawab hai aur saath mukhtasar wajah, jis mein hal ke qadam diye gaye hain.

blocks.prompt:
1 Kinematics is the branch of mechanics that describes the motion of objects:
(Kinematics mechanics ki woh shaakh hai jo objects ki motion (harkat) ko bayan karti hai:)

options.text: sirf un par lagne wali forces se
sirf jab woh rest (sukoon) mein hon

blocks.explanation: Kinematics sirf position, velocity aur acceleration bayan karti hai; motion ki wajah (cause) nahin poochti.

book_ref.quote: Kinematics is the branch of mechanics that describes the motion of objects without considering the causes of motion.

blocks.prompt:
2 The motion of a particle along a straight line is called:
(Particle ki seedhi line (straight line) par motion ko kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Definition ke mutabiq seedhi line par motion rectilinear motion (khat-e-mustaqeem ki harkat) hai.

book_ref.quote: The motion of a particle along a straight line is called rectilinear motion.

blocks.prompt:
3 Which one of the following is an example of rectilinear motion?
(In mein se kaun si rectilinear motion ki misaal hai?)

options.text: Lift jo shaft mein upar neeche jaati hai
Ghoomte hue ceiling fan ka blade

blocks.explanation: Rectilinear motion mein particle sirf aik fixed line par aage ya peeche chalta hai. Lift aik vertical line par chalti hai; baqi sab curve (mur'ne wale raaste) par chalte hain.

book_ref.quote: the particle moves only forwards or backwards along one fixed line

blocks.prompt:
4 Which one of the following is a scalar quantity?
(In mein se kaun si scalar quantity hai?)
blocks.explanation: Scalar sirf magnitude (miqdaar) se poori tarah bayan hoti hai. Speed ki koi direction (simt) nahin; velocity, displacement aur acceleration vectors hain.

book_ref.quote: Scalar quantities are those that are completely described by magnitude only

blocks.prompt:
5 A speed of \(72\) km/h is equal to:
(\(72\) km/h ki speed kitne m/s ke barabar hai?)
blocks.explanation: km/h se m/s ke liye \(\frac{5}{18}\) se zarb dein: \(72 \times \frac{5}{18} = 20\) m/s.

book_ref.quote: Its common units are m/s and km/h.

blocks.prompt:
6 A speed of \(15\) m/s is equal to:
(\(15\) m/s ki speed kitne km/h hai?)
blocks.explanation: m/s se km/h ke liye \(\frac{18}{5}\) se zarb dein: \(15 \times \frac{18}{5} = 54\) km/h.

book_ref.quote: Speed: Rate at which distance is covered per unit time, irrespective of direction.

blocks.prompt:
7 The distance travelled by a moving particle:
(Chalte particle ka tay kiya hua distance (faasla):)

options.text: peeche jaane par negative ho sakta hai
wapsi ke safar mein hamesha zero hota hai
sirf shuru aur aakhri position par munhasir hai

blocks.explanation: Distance raaste ki kul lambai hai, direction se be-niyaz; is liye yeh kabhi negative nahin hota.

book_ref.quote: Distance: Total length of the path travelled, regardless of direction.

blocks.prompt:
8 Which one of the following sets contains only vector quantities?
(Kis set mein sirf vector quantities hain?)
blocks.explanation: Displacement, velocity aur acceleration ki magnitude aur direction dono hain. Distance, speed aur time scalars hain.

book_ref.quote: Vector quantities are described by both magnitude and direction.

blocks.prompt:
9 A girl walks \(5\) m east and then \(12\) m west along a straight road. Her displacement is:
(Aik larki seedhi sarak par \(5\) m east aur phir \(12\) m west chalti hai. Us ka displacement kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: East ko positive lein: \(5 + (-12) = -7\) m, yani \(7\) m west. (\(17\) m distance hai, displacement nahin.)

book_ref.quote: Displacement is change in position of a particle represented by a vector from initial to final position.

blocks.prompt:
10 A swimmer swims from one end of a \(50\) m straight pool to the other end and back, two times. His distance and displacement are:
(Aik tairaak \(50\) m lambe seedhe pool ke aik sire se doosre sire tak aur wapas, do dafa tairta hai. Us ka distance aur displacement kya hain?)
blocks.explanation: Har lambai \(50\) m, kul \(4\) lambaiyan: distance \(= 200\) m. Woh wahin khatam karta hai jahan se shuru kiya, is liye displacement \(= 0\).

book_ref.quote: Depends on the path taken

blocks.prompt:
11 Speed is:
(Speed kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Velocity vector hai aur us ki magnitude (miqdaar) speed hai.

book_ref.quote: It is vector quantity and its magnitude gives speed.

blocks.prompt:
12 The rate of change of velocity with respect to time, including direction, is called:
(Waqt ke lehaaz se velocity ki tabdeeli ki sharah (rate), direction samait, kya kehlati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Definition ke mutabiq acceleration velocity ki waqt ke saath tabdeeli ka rate hai; yeh vector hai.

book_ref.quote: Acceleration: Rate of change of velocity with respect to time, including direction.

blocks.prompt:
13 The average velocity of an object is defined as:
(Kisi object ki average velocity ki definition kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Average velocity mein displacement istemal hota hai; total distance / total time average speed hai.

book_ref.quote: defined as the total displacement divided by the total time taken

blocks.prompt:
14 A cyclist rides \(150\) m north in \(30\) s and then \(50\) m south in \(20\) s along a straight road. His average speed is:
(Aik cyclist seedhi sarak par \(30\) s mein \(150\) m north aur phir \(20\) s mein \(50\) m south chalta hai. Us ki average speed kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Total distance \(= 200\) m, total time \(= 50\) s, average speed \(= \frac{200}{50} = 4\) m/s. Do speeds ka average (\(3.75\)) lena ghalat hai.

book_ref.quote: The average speed of an object is defined as the total distance travelled divided by the total time taken:

blocks.prompt:
15 For the same cyclist (\(150\) m north in \(30\) s, then \(50\) m south in \(20\) s), the average velocity is:
(Usi cyclist (\(30\) s mein \(150\) m north, phir \(20\) s mein \(50\) m south) ki average velocity kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: North ko positive lein: displacement \(= 150 - 50 = 100\) m; average velocity \(= \frac{100}{50} = 2\) m/s north.

book_ref.quote: Taking east as positive and west as negative:

blocks.prompt:
16 The position of a particle is \(x(t) = 2t^{3} - 9t^{2} + 12t\) (\(x\) in m, \(t\) in s). Its velocity at \(t = 3\) s is:
(Particle ki position \(x(t) = 2t^{3} - 9t^{2} + 12t\) hai (\(x\) m mein, \(t\) s mein). \(t = 3\) s par velocity kya hai?)

book_ref.quote: is the rate of change of displacement with respect to time at a given instant

blocks.prompt:
17 For \(x(t) = 2t^{3} - 9t^{2} + 12t\), the particle is momentarily at rest at:
(\(x(t) = 2t^{3} - 9t^{2} + 12t\) ke liye particle kis waqt lamhaati taur par rest (sukoon) mein hai?)

book_ref.quote: momentarily at rest (this is where a particle can turn back)

blocks.prompt:
18 A particle moves so that \(x(t) = t^{2} - 8t\) (m, s). Its speed at \(t = 2\) s is:
(Particle ki position \(x(t) = t^{2} - 8t\) (m, s) hai. \(t = 2\) s par us ki speed kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(v = 2t - 8\), \(v(2) = -4\) m/s; speed \(= |v| = 4\) m/s. Speed kabhi negative nahin hoti.

book_ref.quote: Instantaneous speed is the magnitude of instantaneous velocity

blocks.prompt:
19 If \(x(t) = t^{3} - 4t^{2} + 5\) (m, s), the acceleration at \(t = 2\) s is:
(Agar \(x(t) = t^{3} - 4t^{2} + 5\) (m, s) ho to \(t = 2\) s par acceleration kya hai?)

book_ref.quote: Rate of change of velocity with respect to time is called acceleration.

blocks.prompt:
20 The velocity of a particle in terms of its displacement is \(v = 2x + 3\). Its acceleration when \(x = 1\) is:
(Particle ki velocity displacement ke function ke taur par \(v = 2x + 3\) hai. \(x = 1\) par acceleration kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Yahan \(v\), \(x\) ka function hai, is liye \(a = v\frac{dv}{dx} = (2x + 3)(2)\); \(x = 1\) par \(a = 10\).

book_ref.quote: of the particle is given as a function of displacement

blocks.prompt:
21 If displacement is measured in metres and time in seconds, the unit of acceleration is:
(Agar displacement metre mein aur time second mein ho to acceleration ka unit kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Acceleration = velocity (m/s) ki tabdeeli fi second: \(\frac{\text{m/s}}{\text{s}} = \text{m/s}^{2}\).

book_ref.quote: then unit of acceleration is meters per second square

blocks.prompt:
22 At some instant a particle has \(v = 5\) m/s and \(a = -3\) m/s\(^{2}\). At that instant the particle is:
(Kisi lamhe par particle ki \(v = 5\) m/s aur \(a = -3\) m/s\(^{2}\) hai. Us waqt particle:)

options.text: positive direction mein chal raha hai aur raftaar barh rahi hai
negative direction mein chal raha hai aur raftaar kam ho rahi hai
lamhaati taur par rest mein hai
positive direction mein chal raha hai aur raftaar kam ho rahi hai

blocks.explanation: \(v > 0\): positive direction mein. \(v\) aur \(a\) ke signs ulte hain, is liye raftaar kam ho rahi hai.

book_ref.quote: so the particle is speeding up in the negative direction

blocks.prompt:
23 For any journey along a straight line, which statement is always true?
(Seedhi line par kisi bhi safar ke liye kaun sa bayan hamesha durust hai?)

options.text: jab bhi displacement \(0\) ho to \(\text{average speed} = 0\)

blocks.explanation: Kyunke \(|\text{displacement}| \le \text{distance}\), aik hi total time se taqseem karne par \(|\text{average velocity}| \le \text{average speed}\).

book_ref.quote: The magnitude of the average velocity can never be more than the average speed

blocks.prompt:
24 The slope of a displacement-time graph represents the:
(Displacement-time graph ka slope (dhalwan) kya zahir karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Slope \(= \frac{dx}{dt}\), jo velocity hai.

book_ref.quote: represents velocity of the particle.

blocks.prompt:
25 A horizontal straight segment on a displacement-time graph shows that the particle is:
(Displacement-time graph par horizontal seedha hissa batata hai ke particle:)

options.text: yaksaan velocity se chal raha hai
yaksaan acceleration se chal raha hai

blocks.explanation: Horizontal ka matlab \(x\) nahin badalta, is liye \(v = 0\): particle rest (sukoon) mein hai.

book_ref.quote: the particle is at rest and the displacement-time graph is a horizontal line

blocks.prompt:
26 A displacement-time graph is a straight line from \((0, 0)\) to \((4, 20)\) (\(t\) in s, \(x\) in m). The velocity is:
(Displacement-time graph \((0, 0)\) se \((4, 20)\) tak seedhi line hai (\(t\) s mein, \(x\) m mein). Velocity kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Velocity \(=\) slope \(= \frac{20}{4} = 5\) m/s.

book_ref.quote: the displacement-time graph is a straight line.

blocks.prompt:
27 On a displacement-time graph a straight segment falls from \((2, 30)\) to \((5, 0)\) (\(t\) in h, \(x\) in km). The velocity on this segment is:
(Displacement-time graph par seedha hissa \((2, 30)\) se \((5, 0)\) tak girta hai (\(t\) h mein, \(x\) km mein). Is hisse par velocity kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Slope \(= \frac{0 - 30}{5 - 2} = -10\) km/h. Minus ka matlab negative direction mein harkat.

book_ref.quote: the particle moves in the opposite direction, and the displacement time graph is a falling straight line

blocks.prompt:
28 A displacement-time graph joins \(O(0, 0)\), \(A(10, 3)\), \(B(25, 3)\), \(C(35, 0)\) with straight lines (\(t\) in minutes, \(x\) in km). The average speed for the whole journey is:
(Displacement-time graph \(O(0, 0)\), \(A(10, 3)\), \(B(25, 3)\), \(C(35, 0)\) ko seedhi lines se jorta hai (\(t\) minutes, \(x\) km). Poore safar ki average speed kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Distance \(= 6\) km, time \(= 35\) min (rukne ka waqt bhi shamil): \(\frac{6}{35} \times 60 = \frac{72}{7}\) km/h.

book_ref.quote: Waiting time counts in the total time of a journey.

blocks.prompt:
29 For the same graph \(O(0, 0)\), \(A(10, 3)\), \(B(25, 3)\), \(C(35, 0)\) (minutes, km), the velocity from \(B\) to \(C\) is:
(Usi graph \(O(0, 0)\), \(A(10, 3)\), \(B(25, 3)\), \(C(35, 0)\) (minutes, km) mein \(B\) se \(C\) tak velocity kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Slope \(= \frac{-3}{10} = -0.3\) km/min \(= -18\) km/h (negative slope: wapsi).

book_ref.quote: Positive slope: forward motion. Negative slope: backward motion.

blocks.prompt:
30 If a displacement-time graph is a curve, the velocity at an instant is:
(Agar displacement-time graph curve ho to kisi lamhe par velocity kya hai?)

options.text: us point par tangent ka slope
us point par graph ki unchai
us point tak graph ke neeche ka area

blocks.explanation: Curve par velocity badalti rehti hai; kisi lamhe par yeh \(\frac{dx}{dt}\), yani tangent ka slope hai.

book_ref.quote: the velocity at an instant is the slope of the tangent at that point

blocks.prompt:
31 The slope of a velocity-time graph represents the:
(Velocity-time graph ka slope kya zahir karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Slope \(= \frac{dv}{dt}\), jo acceleration hai.

book_ref.quote: represents acceleration of the particle.

blocks.prompt:
32 The area under a velocity-time graph (above the time axis) between two instants gives the:
(Velocity-time graph ke neeche (time axis ke upar) do lamhon ke darmiyan area kya deta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Area \(= \int_{t_{1}}^{t_{2}} v\,dt = x(t_{2}) - x(t_{1})\), yani displacement.

book_ref.quote: Displacement = Area under velocity-time graph

blocks.prompt:
33 A horizontal straight segment on a velocity-time graph shows that the particle is moving with:
(Velocity-time graph par horizontal seedha hissa batata hai ke particle:)

options.text: yaksaan velocity (\(a = 0\)) se chal raha hai
yaksaan acceleration se chal raha hai
yaksaan retardation se chal raha hai

blocks.explanation: Horizontal ka matlab \(v\) constant hai, \(a = 0\): yaksaan velocity, rest nahin.

book_ref.quote: the velocity-time graph is a horizontal straight line

blocks.prompt:
34 A velocity-time graph is a straight line from \((0, 4)\) to \((6, 16)\) (\(t\) in s, \(v\) in m/s). The acceleration is:
(Velocity-time graph \((0, 4)\) se \((6, 16)\) tak seedhi line hai (\(t\) s, \(v\) m/s). Acceleration kya hai?)

book_ref.quote: is moving with constant acceleration, its velocity-time graph is a straight line

blocks.prompt:
35 For the same graph (straight line from \((0, 4)\) to \((6, 16)\), m/s and s), the displacement in the \(6\) s is:
(Usi graph (\((0, 4)\) se \((6, 16)\) tak seedhi line) ke liye \(6\) s mein displacement kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Trapezium ka area \(= \frac{1}{2}(4 + 16) \times 6 = 60\) m.

book_ref.quote: displacement of the particle during the time interval from

blocks.prompt:
36 A velocity-time graph encloses an area \(A_{1} = 30\) m above the time axis and \(A_{2} = 12\) m below it. The distance travelled is:
(Velocity-time graph time axis ke upar \(A_{1} = 30\) m aur neeche \(A_{2} = 12\) m area gherta hai. Tay kiya hua distance kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Distance \(= A_{1} + A_{2} = 42\) m (displacement \(= A_{1} - A_{2} = 18\) m hota).

book_ref.quote: is the area below time axis and graph

blocks.prompt:
37 A particle's velocity falls uniformly from \(20\) m/s at \(t = 0\) to \(-8\) m/s at \(t = 7\) s. Its displacement in these \(7\) s is:
(Particle ki velocity \(t = 0\) par \(20\) m/s se \(t = 7\) s par \(-8\) m/s tak yaksaan kam hoti hai. In \(7\) s mein displacement kya hai?)

book_ref.quote: If velocity-time graph lies both above and below the time axis

blocks.prompt:
38 A particle starts from rest, reaches \(10\) m/s uniformly at \(t = 4\) s, keeps this velocity until \(t = 14\) s and then comes to rest uniformly at \(t = 18\) s. Its displacement is:
(Particle rest se chal kar \(t = 4\) s par yaksaan \(10\) m/s tak pohanchta hai, \(t = 14\) s tak yehi velocity rakhta hai aur \(t = 18\) s par yaksaan ruk jaata hai. Displacement kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Trapezium: parallel sides \(18\) aur \(10\), height \(10\): \(\frac{1}{2}(28)(10) = 140\) m.

book_ref.quote: A trapezium (trapezoid) is a four-sided plane figure that has exactly one pair of parallel sides.

blocks.prompt:
39 For the same particle (\(10\) m/s from \(t = 4\) s to \(t = 14\) s, rest at \(t = 18\) s), the acceleration in the last \(4\) s is:
(Usi particle (\(t = 4\) se \(t = 14\) s tak \(10\) m/s, \(t = 18\) s par rest) ki aakhri \(4\) s mein acceleration kya hai?)

book_ref.quote: the particle is moving with uniform negative acceleration (retardation)

blocks.prompt:
40 A velocity-time graph which is a curve (not a straight line) shows that the particle is moving with:
(Velocity-time graph agar curve ho (seedhi line nahin) to particle:)

options.text: badalti (variable) acceleration se chal raha hai
constant acceleration se chal raha hai
zero acceleration se chal raha hai
constant velocity se chal raha hai

blocks.explanation: Seedhi line ka slope har jagah aik jaisa; curve ka slope badalta hai, yani acceleration variable (badalti) hai.

book_ref.quote: then its velocity-time graph is not a straight line

blocks.prompt:
41 The velocity of a particle is \(v(t) = 3t^{2}\) m/s. Its displacement from \(t = 1\) s to \(t = 3\) s is:
(Particle ki velocity \(v(t) = 3t^{2}\) m/s hai. \(t = 1\) s se \(t = 3\) s tak displacement kya hai?)

book_ref.quote: Adding all strips is exactly what the integral

blocks.prompt:
42 The equations \(v = u + at\), \(x = ut + \frac{1}{2}at^{2}\) and \(2ax = v^{2} - u^{2}\) can be used only when:
(Equations \(v = u + at\), \(x = ut + \frac{1}{2}at^{2}\) aur \(2ax = v^{2} - u^{2}\) sirf kab istemal ho sakti hain?)

options.text: jab particle rest se shuru kare
jab acceleration time par munhasir ho

blocks.explanation: Yeh \(\frac{dv}{dt} = a\) ko constant \(a\) ke saath integrate kar ke bani hain; badalti acceleration mein seedha integrate karte hain.

book_ref.quote: These three equations are valid only when the acceleration is constant.

blocks.prompt:
43 Integrating \(\frac{dv}{dt} = a\) (constant) gives \(v = at + c\). With \(v = u\) at \(t = 0\), the constant \(c\) equals:
(\(\frac{dv}{dt} = a\) (constant) ko integrate karne se \(v = at + c\). \(t = 0\) par \(v = u\) ho to \(c\) kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(t = 0\) rakhein: \(u = 0 + c\), is liye \(c = u\) aur \(v = u + at\).

book_ref.quote: So the constant is just the starting velocity

blocks.prompt:
44 The equation of motion that does not contain the time \(t\) is:
(Equation of motion jis mein time \(t\) shamil nahin:)
blocks.explanation: \(2ax = v^{2} - u^{2}\) mein se \(t\) eliminate (khatam) kiya gaya hai.

book_ref.quote: Substitute this into equation (4) to eliminate

blocks.prompt:
45 A car moving at \(4\) m/s accelerates uniformly at \(2.5\) m/s\(^{2}\) for \(6\) s. Its velocity at the end is:
(\(4\) m/s se chalti car \(6\) s tak \(2.5\) m/s\(^{2}\) ki yaksaan acceleration leti hai. Aakhir mein velocity kya hai?)

book_ref.quote: These equations are frequently used to describe and analyze the motion of a particle under constant acceleration.

blocks.prompt:
46 A train starts from rest with a uniform acceleration of \(0.5\) m/s\(^{2}\). The distance covered in \(40\) s is:
(Train rest se \(0.5\) m/s\(^{2}\) ki yaksaan acceleration se chalti hai. \(40\) s mein kitna faasla tay karti hai?)

book_ref.quote: Each equation links four of the five quantities

blocks.prompt:
47 A car moving at \(25\) m/s is brought to rest with uniform retardation in a distance of \(50\) m. Its acceleration is:
(\(25\) m/s se chalti car yaksaan retardation se \(50\) m mein ruk jaati hai. Us ki acceleration kya hai?)

book_ref.quote: Find the quantity that is neither given nor asked, and pick the equation that does not contain it

blocks.prompt:
48 A motorbike speeds up uniformly from \(6\) m/s to \(14\) m/s while covering \(40\) m. Its acceleration is:
(Motorbike \(40\) m tay karte hue \(6\) m/s se \(14\) m/s tak yaksaan tez hoti hai. Acceleration kya hai?)

book_ref.quote: By simplification, we get:

blocks.prompt:
49 In deriving \(x = ut + \frac{1}{2}at^{2}\), the constant of integration \(c_{1}\) comes out zero because:
(\(x = ut + \frac{1}{2}at^{2}\) derive karte hue constant \(c_{1}\) zero kyun aata hai?)

options.text: har constant of integration zero hota hai
shuru ka point \(t = 0\) par \(x = 0\) liya gaya hai

blocks.explanation: \(x = 0\), \(t = 0\) rakhne se \(c_{1} = 0\). Agar particle \(x_{0}\) se shuru hota to \(c_{1} = x_{0}\).

book_ref.quote: because we chose the starting point

blocks.prompt:
50 A particle has acceleration \(a(t) = 6t\) m/s\(^{2}\) and velocity \(2\) m/s at \(t = 0\). Its velocity at \(t = 2\) s is:
(Particle ki acceleration \(a(t) = 6t\) m/s\(^{2}\) hai aur \(t = 0\) par velocity \(2\) m/s. \(t = 2\) s par velocity kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(v = 3t^{2} + c\), \(c = 2\); \(v(2) = 14\) m/s. Badalti acceleration mein \(v = u + at\) nahin lagti.

book_ref.quote: For variable acceleration integrate:

blocks.prompt:
51 A particle starts from rest at \(t = 0\) with acceleration \(a(t) = \sin t\). Its velocity is:
(Particle \(t = 0\) par rest se chalta hai aur acceleration \(a(t) = \sin t\) hai. Velocity kya hai?)

book_ref.quote: In Examples 9 and 10 the acceleration changes with time

blocks.prompt:
52 The velocity of a particle is \(v(t) = 4 - 2t\) m/s and \(x = 0\) at \(t = 0\). Its position at \(t = 3\) s is:
(Particle ki velocity \(v(t) = 4 - 2t\) m/s hai aur \(t = 0\) par \(x = 0\). \(t = 3\) s par position kya hai?)

book_ref.quote: integration recovers a quantity from its rate

blocks.text: 7.1.7 Motion of a Free Particle Moving Along a Vertical Line

blocks.prompt:
53 In free vertical motion the acceleration due to gravity is taken as:
(Free vertical motion mein gravity ki wajah se acceleration kitni li jaati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Kitab \(g \approx 9.8\) m/s\(^{2}\) leti hai (hawa ki rukawat nazar-andaz).

book_ref.quote: The acceleration due to gravity is denoted by

blocks.prompt:
54 At the highest point of a ball thrown vertically upward:
(Upar ki taraf seedhi phenki gayi gend ke sab se ooncha point par:)
blocks.explanation: Sab se ooncha point par velocity zero hoti hai, magar gravity phir bhi lagti hai: acceleration \(g\) neeche ki taraf.

book_ref.quote: becomes zero at the highest point

blocks.prompt:
55 A stone is dropped from a high bridge. Its speed after \(2.5\) s is:
(Aik pathar ooncha pul se giraya jaata hai. \(2.5\) s baad us ki speed kya hai?)

book_ref.quote: If the particle moves downward, it accelerates toward the ground at the rate

blocks.prompt:
56 A ball is thrown vertically upward with \(14.7\) m/s. The time to reach the highest point is:
(Gend \(14.7\) m/s se seedhi upar phenki jaati hai. Sab se ooncha point tak pohanchne ka waqt kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(0 = 14.7 - 9.8t\), \(t = 1.5\) s. (\(3\) s wapas aane ka waqt hai.)

book_ref.quote: If a particle is projected upward, its velocity decreases uniformly due to gravity

blocks.prompt:
57 The maximum height reached by a ball thrown vertically upward with \(19.6\) m/s is:
(\(19.6\) m/s se seedhi upar phenki gend ki maximum height kya hai?)

book_ref.quote: When a particle moves under the influence of gravity alone and air resistance is neglected

blocks.prompt:
58 For a particle moving vertically upward (upward taken as positive), the velocity after time \(t\) is:
(Upar jaate particle ke liye (upar positive), time \(t\) ke baad velocity kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Upar ki harkat mein \(a = -g\), is liye \(v = u - gt\).

book_ref.quote: Rising: gravity acts against the motion

blocks.prompt:
59 A stone is dropped from the top of a tower \(78.4\) m high. The time it takes to reach the ground is:
(Aik pathar \(78.4\) m oonche tower ki chot'ti se giraya jaata hai. Zameen tak pohanchne mein kitna waqt lagta hai?)

book_ref.quote: means released without a push
